stage1.impression: A moody idea: a red glowing box in the dark with a red fan of light on the concrete behind it. But the speaker reads as a glowing lamp, not a $20,000 object. Its top piece is a dull, almost invisible red slab. The ground is a patchwork of hard-edged black blots over tiles that looks like a broken shadow mask. A black puck and a bright disc in front of the plinth read as debris. Overall it reads as a dark game screenshot, not a night photograph.

blocking_9: The ground reads as wet board-formed paving: no hard-edged black blotches, and the puddle edges soft and believable
The horn on top is lit and reads as tinted resin (median lum on the horn above 35), not a dead dark slab
Nothing in front of the plinth distracts: no black puck, no bright disc, no visible beam shaft
The colour on the wall reads as the subject: a defined, saturated wash rising from behind the speaker to near the top of the frame
The plinth reads as a solid black base with a frosted lens, with the speaker visibly standing on it, and a contact shadow and colour spill onto the ground
Overall exposure lifts enough that the night set reads with detail (no more than 10% of the frame crushed) while the cabinet face stays unclipped

defects.what: The paving's wet or puddle mask makes large, hard-edged, pure-black blobs (19.7% crushed) that read as cut-out shadows, not water
A black cylinder (the horn uplight housing) sits in front of the plinth with a visible grey haze shaft rising from it: it reads as stray debris
A bright white disc (a glow lens or its reflection) in front of the plinth pulls the eye away from the product
The horn is almost black (median lum 9.7, R 42, G 1, B 1): it reads as a flat dark-red slab with one stray specular glint at its right corner
The right half of the wall is crushed (median lum 4, 26% crushed): the frame is lopsided and the concrete texture is lost
The red wash on the wall is weak (R median 68) and fades before the top of the frame; the light shape reads as two diffuse lobes, not a single rising fan
The plinth reads as a dark box band with no lens edge and no contact shadow; the speaker seems to hover above a black slot
The ports and the bottom of the cabinet are near white (R 246, median lum 179), so the colour washes out to pink at the base
The whole frame is underexposed (94% of pixels below lum 40) and reads as a game scene, not a photograph

changes.problem: The paving's puddle mask makes hard black blobs that read as broken shadows, not wet concrete.

evidence.measured: crush_pct 19.7, lum_median 8.5; large blots with hard edges, alternating with dry tiles

change.to: wet 0.35, puddle_m 2.5 (fewer, larger, softer puddles), or wet 0.25 with no puddles; vary 0.2 kept

changes.expected: The ground reads as uniformly damp paving with soft-edged sheen and tiles visible across the frame; crushed pixels on the ground fall below 8%.

changes.problem: The horn uplight's housing and lens sit in view in front of the plinth as a black puck and a white disc, with a beam shaft through the haze.

evidence.measured: lum_range 199 in 330-470 x 700-780; a black cylinder next to a near-white disc (p95 202)

change.from: housing and glow disc at y -0.615 on the ground, in frame
change.to: remove props 4 and 5 (the fixture) and keep lights.up-horn as a hidden lamp, or move it into the plinth's front edge at y -0.27, z 0.08, so no fixture shows

changes.expected: Clean paving in front of the plinth; only the product and its plinth glow in the lower centre.

changes.problem: The horn is dead dark and reads as a flat slab, so the speaker's silhouette loses its crown.

change.to: target [0, 0, 1.0] (the horn's centre), cone 22, blend 0.6, 420 W, aimed so the beam lands on the horn and not on the wall

changes.expected: The horn's resin glows red with a visible gradient through its thickness and reads as cast material; the cabinet's top edge and the posts separate.

changes.problem: The colour on the wall, which is the frame's subject, is weak and splits into two lobes that fade before the top of the frame.

evidence.measured: R median 68-76; y falloff bins 22.9 to 27.9 to 14.6, peaking high and dropping toward the speaker

change.to: spread 45, 520 W (a tighter, stronger fan rising up the wall)

changes.expected: One saturated fan of colour rising from behind the speaker, brightest near the cabinet top and fading smoothly upward, with board marks legible in it.

changes.problem: The right half of the wall falls to black, so the frame looks lopsided and the concrete is lost.

evidence.measured: lum_median 4.0, crush_pct 26.4, against lum_median 10.9 on the left

change.to: position [-1.0, -2.0, 5.0] (higher and more frontal so it grazes the whole wall), irradiance 0.8

changes.expected: Faint cool board texture reads across the full wall width; neither side crushed.

changes.problem: The plinth reads as a dark slot with no edge or lens, so the speaker hovers instead of standing.

evidence.measured: a dark band under the cabinet; no lens rim or contact shadow is visible

change.to: roughness 0.3, ease 0.012 (a rounded edge that catches a highlight), glow emit 0.2 so the frosted lens's rim shows around the cabinet foot

changes.expected: A thin glowing line where the cabinet meets the lens, and a readable black block edge on the plinth.

changes.problem: The frame is underexposed overall, yet the cabinet's base is near white and loses its colour.

evidence.measured: R 246, G 161, B 154, median lum 179; frame-wide 94% of pixels below lum 40

change.setting: render exposure (with lights.up power from c4)
change.to: exposure 1.35, with lights.up's colour temperature kept and its power capped so the port area does not exceed lum 200 median

changes.expected: The set lifts out of black while the base keeps its red: G and B in the port band drop relative to R.

changes.problem: The speaker sits small in the lower middle with a lot of dead wall, so the hero reads at a glance only as a lamp.

evidence.measured: the product spans about 23% of the frame width; the top 35% is dim wall

change.to: 50 mm at [0.2, -3.6, 0.8], target z 1.15, so the speaker fills about 28% of the width and the wall wash still reaches the top

changes.expected: The product reads larger with its full horn and plinth in frame, and the wall's colour fills the upper half.

out_of_scope.request: Make the horn's tinted resin pass more light so it glows like the cabinet
out_of_scope.why: That changes the product's material or colour, which is fixed.
